links.outcome: Faithfulness of clinical summaries with automated verification and targeted correction versus vanilla LLMs and baselines
links.effect: Reported consistent improvements over vanilla LLMs and other strong baselines across reference-based metrics, LLM-as-a-judge, and human evaluation; no numeric values in the provided text.
links.quote: Across various measures, AgenticSum demonstrates consistent improvements compared to vanilla LLMs and other strong baselines.

unlisted_practices: Attention-grounding-based detection of weakly supported spans in generated summaries with selective revision
Context compression and selection stage before summary generation

screen.reason: The study develops and benchmarks a new agentic inference-time framework (AgenticSum) for clinical text summarization against standard LLMs on public datasets, representing model/pipeline architecture rather than an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
